This pedal is new in the box with full manufacturer warranty. The Crosstown Fuzz is a germanium/silicon hybrid Fuzz F@ce circuit that offers you more control, more flexibility, super low noise operation, and guaranteed stability. Our hand-picked combination of germanium and silicon transistors coupled with an internal bias control gives you the option to tailor the Crosstown’s gain structure to your personal taste without having to worry about stability issues such as overheating. Even at the most extreme settings, the Crosstown gives astonishing note clarity, and when coupled with your guitar’s volume control, can yield pristine yet fat clean tones at almost every setting. In addition to the standard GAIN and VOLUME controls, the Crosstown features two additional knobs for total EQ control. First up is the full range TONE control which allows you to tailor the Crosstown’s treble response from warm and creamy to bright and sizzly. And lastly, the BODY control gives you the ability to either enhance or tame the wooly low end that is characteristic of most fuzz face circuits. Simply crank the BODY for a full and fat bass response, or roll it back for a smoother, creamier tone. This feature also gives the Crosstown the ability to work equally well with both single coil and humbucker equipped guitars. In short, the Crosstown puts an endless array of tones and colors at your feet. Whether you’re looking to recreate the timeless tones of Hendrix and Trower, or create your own signature sound, the Crosstown puts an ample variety of tone shaping capabilities at your disposal. Other features include True Bypass switching, extremely low noise operation, 9V DC jack, bright LED and high quality Die Cast Enclosure. sources.excerpt: Guitar Pedal X - GPX Blog - Mojo Hand FX revives its Crosstown Hybrid 2-Transistor Fuzz - available in Classic and Rasta Editions ao link News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Xploration • Curation • Recommendation News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Filter content by area of interest Amps Boost and Overdrive Delay Distortion Fuzz Guitars Modulation Pitch Reverb Utility All All Mojo Hand FX revives its Crosstown Hybrid 2-Transistor Fuzz - available in Classic and Rasta Editions Sep 23, 2026 12:00 by  Stefan Karlsson Fuzz Fuzz Face Style Fuzz Germanium Fuzz Mojo Hand FX Silicon Fuzz + - Full Article Read Summary Key Points Mojo Hand FX has revived the Crosstown Hybrid 2-Transistor Fuzz in Classic and Rasta Editions. It combines one Germanium and one Silicon transistor; earlier versions used AC187 and BC109, but AC187s became unavailable. A suitable Germanium replacement reportedly took two years to find. Tone, Gain, Volume and Body controls expand the classic Fuzz Face format, with Body balancing its low-end. The pedal is listed at $179; no date or pound equivalent is provided. Both editions are available through the Mojo Hand FX Webstore. No new demos are mentioned, so older demos are referenced. The Crosstown Fuzz is a Hybrid Fuzz Face - utilising one Germanium, and one Silicon Transistor. At one stage these used to be the Ge AC187 and Si BC109 - while Mojo soon ran out of the AC187’s - as those are long since discontinued and in very short supply. Supposedly it has taken Mojo Hand 2 years to find a suitable Germanium Transistor replacement. Which has now happened - although they’re not too keen to reveal what the solution was. There’s a fair amount of Soviet / Ukrainian transistors doing the rounds, and there are also some interesting 2Nx and AC / ACY varieties out there. I’m always keen to know - while the most important thing of course is how good they sound. There still seems to be a ready supply of metal can BC108 and BC109 Transistors though - while surely not all of those can be entirely kosher! Controls - Tone, Gain, Volume, Body. This is obviously a Hybrid and Expanded Fuzz Face - with 4 controls in place of the classic 2. While I typically only buy Germanium Transistor Fuzzes that have an external Bias control. It’s cool to have a Body control here - as some don’t like the amount of low-end you get with some Fuzz Face circuits - and this helps balance that out. The Crosstown Hybrid Fuzz is very fairly priced at $179 - you just need to decide whether you prefer the mostly Orange Classic Edition, or mostly Green Rasta Edition. Both currently available on the Mojo Hand FX Webstore . I have a few Mojo Hand FX pedals to my name - mostly Fuzzes to be honest, and I’ve long since considered adding the Crosstown, while latterly I tend to go for even more expanded and evolved editions - and as I said I do like an external Bias control. So we shall have to wait and see what happens there. I ne

The Crosstown reimagines the classic Fuzz Face circuit with hybrid transistor topology and expanded tonal control. Hand-picked combination of germanium and silicon transistors coupled with internal bias control delivers classic fuzz character without the stability issues that plague vintage units—no overheating, no drift. Beyond standard Gain and Volume controls, the Crosstown adds full-range Tone control (warm and creamy to bright and sizzly) and Body control to enhance or tame the wooly low end characteristic of Fuzz Face circuits. This gives you extensive tone-shaping capability while maintaining that essential Fuzz Face response. True bypass switching with extremely low noise operation, 9V DC jack, and die-cast enclosure. Works equally well with single-coil and humbucker-equipped guitars. Recreates classic Hendrix and Trower tones with modern reliability and control.
